name: MVGS_CM_RD_LOCALIZATION_SO
title: KDK rare-disease variant localization to Sequence Ontology
description: KDK RareDiseasesMolecular *.localization[].code -> SO consequence term for mii-pr-molgen-molekulare-konsequenz.component:feature-consequence (GR molecular-consequence-vs, is-a SO:0001537). Interim until the MolGen Variantenlokalisation of HDB-976 (DISCUSS-TD #26; REVIEW-TD A).

target.comment: SO:0001630 splice_region_variant covers 1-3 bases into the exon or 3-8 bases into the intron only; it excludes the canonical splice sites (+1/+2, -1/-2: SO:0001629 splice_site_variant, a sibling under SO:0001568 splicing_variant), which the KDK 'splicingRegion' also covers. Kept as the interim target (Python and FML emit it) until the MolGen Variantenlokalisation (HDB-976).
